claims.claim_text: 預期 14.9 MB 的東西只到 219 KB，連錯誤都沒有
claims.evidence: Out of a 14.9 MB response, only about 219 KB was sent.

claims.claim_text: 是 hyper 的 dispatch loop 用 let _ 丟掉了 poll_flush() 的 Poll::Pending，在 socket buffer 被填滿時還沒 flush 完就 shutdown，這個 bug 橫跨 0.14、1.7、1.8 等多個大版本躲了好幾年
claims.evidence: the `let _` before `poll_flush` is where the bug lives ... We tested across hyper versions 0.14, 1.7, and 1.8 ... present in hyper for years across multiple major versions.

claims.claim_text: 最後的修法只有四行：在 poll_shutdown() 裡先把 flush 跑完，再送 SHUT_WR
claims.evidence: Before shutting down the socket, hyper should first flush any remaining data ... ready!(self.poll_flush(cx)?); Pin::new(&mut self.io).poll_shutdown(cx)

claims.claim_text: LLM 其實是靠「文風」這個不安全的特徵在辨認 system／user／think 等角色，而不是真的看角色標籤
claims.evidence: both think tags and reasoning-like style activate it ... writing style actively overrides the true tag

claims.claim_text: 偽造 think 角色，攻擊成功率約六成；一旦把那段假推理的文風特徵抹掉，成功率就從 61% 掉到 10%
claims.evidence: CoT Forgery takes attack success rates from near-zero to ~60% ... destyling causes average attack success in our dataset to plunge from 61% to 10%

claims.claim_text: 這是一篇 ICML 2026 的研究
claims.evidence: Prompt Injection as Role Confusion / ICML 2026

claims.evidence: AV1 is enabled on the majority of mobile devices in Meta Real-Time Communication (RTC) applications such as Messenger and WhatsApp.

claims.claim_text: 端到端要壓在 300ms 以下
claims.evidence: end-to-end video latency, which ideally should remain below 300 milliseconds.

claims.evidence: at least a 20% bitrate reduction with AV1 compared with H.264/AVC ... 14% increase in power usage ... [Pixel 8] ... binary 1.7 MB larger

claims.claim_text: 要在 2.4 億個網域名稱上做到 p99 近乎 0ms 的自動完成 ... 整個資料集約 2.5 GB
claims.evidence: p99 0 ms means that 99% of the time, the results will be ready before the user even releases the key ... The 240M domain names take about 2.5 GB of disk space.

claims.claim_text: 二分搜尋 27 MB 目錄後線性掃一個 256 筆的 block。多數請求 2ms 內回應 ... 跨海到美國會多 100-200ms
claims.evidence: binary-searches the directory (27 MB), then linearly scans one block of 256 names ... Most requests are answered within 2 ms ... Traffic from the USA will add 100-200 ms

claims.evidence: On March 8, 2026, British Columbia moved their clocks to a year-round Pacific Daylight Savings Time ... permanently UTC-7.

claims.evidence: your November through March appointments may be off by an hour!

claims.claim_text: Huffman 解碼天生很序列：每個符號得先解完才能解下一個，難以在現代 CPU／GPU 上向量化
claims.evidence: Normal Huffman decoding (and, to a lesser extent, encoding) is inherently quite serial.

claims.claim_text: 「該抓哪些元素」可化約成 prefix sum 這個經典平行原語，於是不必把向量寬度寫死進 bitstream 格式
claims.evidence: figuring out which list elements to grab reduces to a prefix sum ... doesn't need the bitstream to be written with a particular vector width ... in mind.

claims.claim_text: 用 2-6 KB 的預算 shuffle 表換取跨硬體一致的吞吐
claims.evidence: 256*8 bytes = 2KiB ... this version needs around 6KiB of tables

claims.claim_text: Nix 把 /nix/store/<hash>-pkg/ 這種硬編碼路徑塞滿整個二進位，於是想換安裝位置時，光改字串就會 cascade 作廢整張依賴圖、逼你全部重編
claims.evidence: Changing this simple string cascade-invalidates the entire dependency graph. You are now waiting 4 hours for GCC to compile just so you can print 'Hello World' from a different folder.

claims.claim_text: 卡關處在 kernel——PT_INTERP 與 shebang 都不支援 $ORIGIN，所以他認為最乾淨的解是直接 patch kernel
claims.evidence: the Linux Kernel does not support `$ORIGIN` in this field _as of today_ ... same kernel limitation with the shebang line ... I believe augmenting support in the Linux kernel is the right approach.

claims.claim_text: Moebius 是一個只有 2.26 億參數的影像 inpainting 模型，不到 FLUX.1-Fill-Dev（11.9B）的 2%
claims.evidence: Moebius operates with a mere 0.22B (226M) parameters ... less than 2% of the size of ... FLUX.1-Fill-Dev (11.9B)

claims.claim_text: 在 Places2、CelebA-HQ 等六個基準上宣稱與 FLUX.1-Fill-Dev、SD3.5 Large-Inpainting 平手甚至略勝，單步推論 26.01ms、整體加速超過 15 倍
claims.evidence: 6 comprehensive benchmarks ... (Places2) ... (CelebA-HQ, FFHQ) ... on par with, and in certain scenarios surpasses 10B-level ... 26.01 ms per step ... >15× total runtime acceleration

claims.evidence: `deno desktop` ships in Deno v2.9.0 and is not in a stable release yet.

claims.claim_text: 「Microsoft Corporation UEFI CA 2011」憑證即將到期，微軟也將停止用它簽 shim，沒有換上 2023 新憑證的機器，未來新版安裝媒體會開不起來
claims.evidence: shim is signed with a Microsoft key from 2011 that expires ... installation media will no longer boot unless it has an updated shim ... signed with the Microsoft 2023 UEFI key

claims.claim_text: 解法是硬體商透過 LVFS／fwupd 推韌體更新把 2023 金鑰加進 UEFI db，否則就得暫時關掉 Secure Boot 才能完成更新
claims.evidence: Vendors can ... provide firmware updates that add the new key ... LVFS ... which fwupd ... can use ... disabling Secure Boot may be the only option
